points.description: States 'Unbiased' (unbiasedness) as a desirable property of an estimator.

rubric.notes: All four properties are required, each named with its correct technical term: unbiasedness, consistency, efficiency, sufficiency. Each property earns its own 0.5 marks; vague descriptions without the term earn nothing. Any wrong extra property (e.g. 'robustness', 'accuracy') cancels the mark for one correct item, and the total is never below 0.
